invocation.natural_language: Describe the user goal in ordinary language; Codex may select only an implicitly eligible skill whose boundaries match.
invocation.historical: Historical CPP /family:command and faux /skill-name spellings are documentation-only and unsupported by Codex.

implicit_entrypoints.name: flow-auto
implicit_entrypoints.rationale: The lifecycle is a high-value entrypoint with mandatory issue, worktree, approval, and issue-state gates.

implicit_entrypoints.name: project-next
implicit_entrypoints.rationale: Read-only repository triage has direct, indirect, and negative golden prompts and a deterministic behavioral core.

explicit_only.reason: Secondary, help, administrative, and state-changing skills remain selectable with $skill-name or /skills without consuming every session's implicit inventory.
explicit_only.project_init: project-init writes a new local scaffold and is explicit-only under the accepted project-init composition contract.

fresh_full_suite_capture.method: Install the full profile into an isolated CODEX_HOME and capture codex debug prompt-input.

refresh_boundary.reason: An existing session retains the skill inventory and metadata captured when that session started.
